purpose: Choose a practical improvement for one-to-five-word English-to-Japanese translation without weakening the existing translation paths.

split_policy.dev: Candidate selection and all prompt, classifier, and routing adjustments use only these 60 cases. Previously exposed vocabulary, idioms, and sentences belong here.
split_policy.heldout: Do not inspect model outputs or score these 60 cases until the final candidate and routing policy are frozen. Run the baseline and the frozen candidate once for quality; performance repetitions must not prompt further tuning.
split_policy.control: Check the frozen candidate against 24 cases spanning English inputs longer than five words, Japanese-to-English, and mixed text, proper names, established loanwords, and numerals.
split_policy.freshness_limit: The full earlier 78-case corpus was unavailable when this fixture was authored. Heldout inputs are newly selected and exclude the supplied exposed inputs, their obvious derivatives, and the previously mentioned candidates meticulous, ambivalent, and benevolent. This is a prospective split for this experiment, not a claim of proven independence from every earlier experiment or from the models training data.
split_policy.no_post_holdout_tuning: If the frozen candidate fails, report rejection. Do not adjust it against the heldout outputs and re-label the same set as unseen.
split_policy.freeze_evidence: Record the case-file SHA-256, candidate text, routing rules, generation settings, executable revision, and selection rationale before heldout execution.
split_policy.few_shot_overlap_check: Before any heldout generation, the corpus author replaced one heldout item overlapping the fixed few-shot examples. Development inputs and candidate texts were unchanged. The final corpus SHA-256 is recorded in the selection artifact.

short_input_policy.word_definition: Count ASCII alphanumeric runs, joining runs linked by a single apostrophe or hyphen inside a word. ASCII and Unicode apostrophes and hyphens are equivalent. Contractions and hyphenated compounds count as one word. Surrounding Unicode punctuation and Unicode whitespace do not create words.
short_input_policy.unsupported_input: Mixed Japanese, other unsupported letters or symbols, and inputs outside the word limit use the existing path. Word count is independent of tokenizer token count.
short_input_policy.scope_note: The fixture includes valid names and loanwords to ensure they are not rejected merely for looking like transliterations. Numeric and mixed controls exercise the existing path rather than requiring a particular new short-input route.

candidates.apple_preconditions: macOS 26.4 or later, supported SDK, explicit English source and Japanese target, and installed language assets. Record availability and any observed strategy fallback. Language assets may be installed for evaluation; production must not download them automatically.
candidates.candidate_lock: Save the exact candidate texts before dev generation. Freeze the chosen text and classifier/routing before generating heldout outputs.
candidates.single_inference: Select one engine before inference. Do not automatically run a second engine after the first engine begins or fails.

evaluation.assessor: AI assessment; not a human translation study.
evaluation.blinding: Present inputs, acceptable-meaning notes, and anonymized candidate outputs in deterministic randomized order; hide engine and candidate names during scoring. Save the anonymization key separately from the judging input.

score.0: Clear mistranslation or untranslated output: wrong core sense, reversed polarity, lost prohibition, wrong time or participant, unjustified added content, or no meaningful translation.
score.1: Partly useful: recognizable core idea but incomplete or distorted meaning, opaque phonetic rendering, or wording that is too awkward or literal to be practically usable.
score.2: Correct, natural, and practically usable: conveys a defensible intended meaning, preserving relevant polarity, tense, modality, participants, and pragmatic intent.

evaluation.acceptable_meanings_policy: The supplied meanings are semantic guidance, not exact-match reference strings or an exhaustive dictionary. Accept synonyms, appropriate registers, established loanwords, proper-name spellings, and other defensible common senses when the isolated input is ambiguous. Idiom-category cases request the idiomatic meaning; use an ordinary literal sense only when the acceptable-meaning notes explicitly allow it. Do not count opaque phonetic copying of an ordinary non-loanword as score 2.
evaluation.missing_or_error_output: Score 0. Keep the error text and engine availability evidence in the raw result.
evaluation.selection: Use dev results to choose one complete policy. Prefer lower load and fewer branches when quality is equivalent.

quality_gate.reference: Unchanged production baseline evaluated with the same model, build, and generation settings.
quality_gate.heldout_previously_correct_to_clear_mist: No case with baseline score=2 may fall to candidate score=0.
quality_gate.failed_gate: Do not adopt or open an implementation PR claiming a quality improvement. Preserve and report the comparison evidence.
quality_gate.group_score_totals: Candidate score sum must be at least the baseline sum separately for heldout word, heldout idiom, heldout sentence, control long_en, control reverse_ja, and control mixed_other.
quality_gate.regression_report: Report group score totals and all material regressions alongside the pass/fail decision.

performance_gate.measurement: Use identical ordered inputs and generation settings with PLaMo resident in the app. Record cold/first and warm requests separately, elapsed completion time, app memory, and relevant OS-service memory increments. Use repeated warm runs for p95; record sample count, percentile method, process identifiers, OS, architecture, model hash, executable revision, and build configuration.
performance_gate.apple_unavailable: Record the explicit runtime or asset-availability reason. An unavailable strategy is not a quality pass and cannot be selected without real output and performance evidence.

production_and_pr.apple_integration_condition: Add a production Swift bridge only if an Apple strategy meets the gates and is selected.
production_and_pr.lifecycle: Keep translation direction, cancellation, supersession, and stale-result suppression consistent. Apple output may be displayed as a completed response.
verification: Repeated translation, long English, and Japanese-to-English regression
Real app verification of the selected route
production_and_pr.delivery: Create and attach a PR only if the adoption gates pass. Check CI and available GitHub Codex auto review, address material findings, and do not merge or replace the installed app.
